title: Same-at dedupe silently drops the terminal line for taken-over legacy unreachable rows (AC1 event coverage)
detail: Guard drops ANY consecutive same-at line, not just send lines. A pre-migration unreachable row taken over has terminal at = updated_at = taken_over_at (one now() transaction), so the terminal event vanishes.
recommended_fix: Collapse only when both lines are send kinds (invitation_sent/co_nudge/reminder_sent); lifecycle lines must always render (AR-RC13, AC1 'covering every … terminal event').

title: Export outcome mislabels failed rows as 'In progress' (AC2 evidence content)
evidence:
pub fn refcheck_export_outcome(status: String) -> String {
  case status {
    "queued" -> "Waiting to start"
    "skipped" -> "Skipped by the landlord"
    "contact_initiated" -> "Invitation sent, awaiting the form"
    "awaiting_correction" -> "Contact details need correcting"
    "unreachable" -> "Couldn't be reached"
    "refused" -> "Declined to give a reference"
    "objected" -> "Asked not to be contacted"
    "form_completed" -> "Reference received"
    "manual_recorded" -> "Recorded manually"
    "partial" -> "Form left unfinished"
    _ -> "In progress"
  }
}
---
server/src/reference_checks/sql/sweep_mark_failed.sql:13-19
SET status          = 'failed',
    outcome         = NULL,
    terminal_reason = $2,
    next_attempt_at = NULL,
    terminalized_at = now(),
detail: failed is a v1-active terminal state: sweep_mark_failed stamps terminalized_at, so failed rows render the timeline and the export button. Their Outcome line falls through to 'In progress' — a permanent system failure recorded as ongoing.
recommended_fix: Add a "failed" arm consistent with the state copy (e.g. "Hit a problem on our side") before the "In progress" fallback, plus a test pinning it.
